title: Persist operation deduplication and inspectable outcomes
note: DEFERRED VERIFICATION (runner lands in Todo 21). Component tests drive the real SQLite coordinator and Unix PTY holder; they are not an assembled CLI/socket transcript. After assembly, run the declared conformance command with isolated state and record requests, replies, holder bytes and reopen outcomes.

assertions: accepted cancellation persists and never grants execution after reopen
running cancellation returns pending and cannot retract committed work
failed records and typed error kinds survive reopen
changed argv returns op_reused with the original receipt
UUIDv7 older than the acceptance floor returns op_expired
crash after an external write but before acknowledgement is outcome_unknown
actual InputWritten is distinct from actual Exit
missing delivery evidence cannot become committed
typed write and process-exit facts survive retry and reopen
inspection cannot expose Applied rows before COMMIT
snapshot revision and operation event revision equal the committed receipt
generated receipts survive actual SQLite reopen
arbitrary u64 revisions round trip as decimal strings
u64::MAX is exact and JSON numbers yield invalid_params
